note: The shared sound-effect library for NEONOIRE (Nobody's Witness), the Hangar cold open (untitled) and Let the Raptures Commence. `scripts/sfx/build-library.mjs` picks the strongest measured variation of each new effect, levels it into public/audio/sfx/<id>.mp3 and writes library.json and the listening page. `projects` lists where the effect fits (reuse across stories is the point) and says where, per project. The other variations stay in public/audio/sfx/alternates/. Nobody has listened to the new ones: the pick is by measured energy, not by ear, and nothing is wired into an animatic or a game yet.
